_comment: P1's buttons are on the arrow keys, with B on Z, A on X, Select on Tab and Start on Return. Power and the Super Game Boy's other controllers ship unbound.

Each player's buttons are also on that player's game controller (P1 on the first, and so on): the directional pad and the left stick are the arrows, A is A, B is X, Select is Back and Start is Start, as the NES core has them (chimera#336).

Game Boy Controls.P1 Down: Down, J1 POV0D, X1 DpadDown, X1 LStickDown
Game Boy Controls.P1 Left: Left, J1 POV0L, X1 DpadLeft, X1 LStickLeft
Game Boy Controls.P1 Right: Right, J1 POV0R, X1 DpadRight, X1 LStickRight
